English: Journalist interviews a number of Pashdzii aristocrats, finds prevailing opinion is that Poumnaks worship snakes.
Reports emerge on the Strange Na'tau people of Bafozh. These layabouts worship the sun and don't live in one place!
One witness claims Vuyti migrants in $OURCAPITAL$ are engaging in their strange rites right under the noses of the religious police!
An explorer has gotten his hands on a Bafozhi beast man, and is charging a pittance in $CAPITAL$ to have a look at the strange fellow.
In a small village some of the awful folk span on some soldiers. The local police have decided to cane them.
A generous man has given a thrall some Pruub. He said of the matter 'I just couldn't stand the way he would look at me when I smoked.'
A very old man was found in $ANYPROVINCE$ who is certain the world is going to end soon. He said 'I saw it clear as day'.
People in our country are pratically desparate for Pruub, which is always in short supply. One man said 'I need it like a fish needs water'.
Tehurite Family claims to have lived in same land for over 100 generations, since beginning of time.
A leading author in $OURCOUNTRY$ has written a charming new novel. It features the story of a likely heir who has been defrauded of his inheritance.
Rowdy young folk seem to be playing some new game where they whack eachother violently. They call it 'the Pruuntish Game'.
A Historian in $OURCAPITAL$ tells a journalist the Byotrish used to rule much of central Ishahfazh. Their sorry state today is far from this.
A child was recently devoured by a ravenous swarm of locusts. The community is grieving this child who was not brought inside quickly enough.
A thrall was recently heard singing a very beautiful song. Locals moved to tears called it 'the Thrall's lament'.
Two sailors who recently came back from the Boreal Reaches have been suffering from same strange fever. A doctor says it is called 'Boreal Flux' and is caused by extremophile bacteria.
Consumers say fish from Chazd taste the worst. A man said 'They are always too salty. And I don't care for the people of that land.'
Police have uncovered what they say is a vast liberationist conspiracy to kill the highest leaders of our state! They say they are going to hang the conspirators and warn people to be vigilant.
A circus has come through $OURCAPITAL$ saying they have the fattest Poumnak in the world. He is very rotund, but one may says he saw a fatter one once.
A prominent aristocrat killed himself in a particularly tragic way. He leaped off a cliff after denouncing the world.
The police recently found a disoriented man lost in the woods. No one knows where he came from, and he doesn't even know the gods of this land.
Consumers furious that the fraternal order of the Men of The Barrel have sold Maggot Wine containing no Maggots! People said they put rice in instead. It tastes AWFUL!
Inventor claims Levitation Around the Corner
Soon you will see me levitating at the Market in a fortnite's time. Other inventors Skepical.
A very wealthy heir to a large banking fortune has taken out a large loan. Economic pundits worried about state of loan market. "This could cause great problems" says professor.
ADVERTISMENT: I am a shobgizobi Prince. I need help returning to my homeland and need monies as soon as possible. I will remember my benefactors kindly, and return payments in full or more.
A Dashing soldier of fortune has been hanging around drinking establishments moping that the government wouldn't send him to Bafozh. He says "the foriegn minister even called me a 'damn fool'".
There seem to be rising incidents related to ruffianianism and brigandage on the roads of our land. A prominent author says this is entirely due to insidious Free Yoker ideas.
A local man who was severely in debt to Poumnian creditors has by all accounts by dragged away to Poumnia. The saying goes "A coin from a Poumnian costs more than it's worth".
Attention: Worm Cream is now avaliable for sale in $OURCAPITAL$ for very cheap! This cream made is from the finest Bafozhi worms dug out of the Worm Tree, and will cure many ailments.
